ai_summary: Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) has executed a Shareholders' Agreement to facilitate its wholly-owned subsidiary, Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL), raising capital by issuing an equity stake of up to 5.54% to a consortium of prominent institutional investors, including Alpha Wave III, Premji Invest, Temasek, and BlackRock funds. This strategic financing initiative will dilute AEL's full ownership in AAHL but provides a significant capital infusion for the airport operations business, bringing in reputable external validation without any apparent red flags.
